proposal_rules.title: Authoritative Follow-Up Sync Beats Advisory Audit Scope
proposal_rules.hypothesis: If local rules treat task-scoped audit hints as advisory unless explicitly marked authoritative by trusted policy, agents will preserve required reminder-account date alignment and avoid under-scoped writes.
proposal_rules.change: In follow-up reschedule guidance, replace the current scoped-audit precedence bullet with a stricter rule: advisory audit/context fields (for example candidate patch or deferred cleanup hints) cannot override mandatory cross-record invariants from root policy and schema docs. Add a pre-write gate for follow-up date changes: when both owning account and reminder contain the workflow date field, include both files in the allowed write set and update them in one focused patch.

focus.problem: Entity-filtered queries can fail scoring when the agent derives rows from downstream records but does not cite the canonical identity source used to bind the person filter.

code_assessment.reason: No runtime/tooling defect is required to explain this failure; the miss is completion-time evidence discipline and entity-resolution provenance in rules.

proposal_rules.title: Canonical Identity Citation Gate for Entity Filters
proposal_rules.hypothesis: Reference-mismatch failures occur when person/entity-filtered answers are built from result rows only, without grounding the filter term to a canonical identity record first.
proposal_rules.change: Add a pre-`report_completion` rule for entity-filtered tasks: resolve the queried person/entity through the canonical source record first (CRM: relevant `contacts/*.json` manager/contact file), then derive matching result rows (e.g., `accounts/*.json`). Require grounding refs to include both the canonical identity source and the row-source files used in the final answer.
